**Love, a Quiet Fire**

In the hush between two breaths  
there is a spark that refuses to dim,  
a quiet fire that lingers  
in the corners of our eyes.

It is not the thunder of a storm,  
nor the blaze of a summer noon—  
it is the steady glow of a candle  
lit in the dark, steady and sure.

It is the way a hand finds another’s,  
the unspoken promise in a touch,  
the rhythm of two hearts beating  
in sync, even when the world turns slow.

Love is the soft echo of laughter,  
the shared silence after a storm,  
the memory of a song that lingers  
long after the last note fades.

It is the courage to be seen,  
to lay bare the scars and the dreams,  
to walk together through the unknown,  
hand in hand, heart to heart.

In the quiet moments, love whispers,  
“Here, in this space, we are enough.”  
And in that whisper, we find the truth:  
Love is not a fleeting flame,  
but a steady, enduring light—  
a quiet fire that keeps us warm,  
no matter how cold the night.
